title: Apply to add a class to a NSW driving instructor licence (under mutual recognition)
summary: This page outlines the process and requirements for adding a new class to an existing NSW driving instructor licence under mutual recognition.
intro:
If you've been recognised as a NSW driving instructor under mutual recognition, you're able to add a class to your licence if you wish.

Before you get your upgraded driving instructor licence, Transport for NSW (TfNSW) needs to confirm that:

You can submit your initial application online or at a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Hold a current NSW driving instructor licence.
Hold a current full (unrestricted) driver licence.
Have held an unrestricted driver licence in the class you wish to add, for a minimum of 3 of the last 4 years (if applicable).
Hold, or have evidence you are applying for, an employee WWCC number (if adding Class C or Class R).
what_you_need: Payment of the non-refundable upgrade fee at a service centre.
Your current NSW employee Working With Children Check (WWCC) number (if adding Class C or Class R).
A secondary proof of identity document (if you hold an interstate driver licence).
Scanned PDF copies of your driver licence and traffic record details from the original state/territory or New Zealand (if applicable).
A copy of your Certificate IV in Transport and Logistics for the new class.
Successful completion of the instructor knowledge test (90 questions) in English and without interpreter assistance for the class of licence you are adding.
The PDF forms: Notice for Registration of Equivalent Occupation Driving Instructor's Licence – PDF (required for all upgrades).

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Notice for Registration of Equivalent Occupation Driving Instructor's Licence – PDF.
Select the 'Apply online' button.Note: You cannot save and resume your application once you've started.
Follow the prompts to submit your application.
Visit a service centre and submit your application.

faqs.q: Who can apply to add a class to their driving instructor licence?
faqs.a: You must hold a current NSW driving instructor licence and a current full (unrestricted) driver licence. You must also have held an unrestricted driver licence in the class you wish to add for a minimum of 3 of the last 4 years (if applicable). If adding Class C or Class R, you must hold, or be applying for, an employee WWCC number.

faqs.q: What documents are needed to apply for an upgrade?
faqs.a: You need your driver licence and your driving instructor licence, proof of paying the non-refundable upgrade fee at a service centre, and your current NSW employee Working With Children Check (WWCC) number if adding Class C or Class R. Other required items include a secondary proof of identity document (if holding an interstate licence), scanned PDF copies of your original state/territory or New Zealand driver licence and traffic record details (if applicable), and a copy of your Certificate IV in Transport and Logistics for the new class.

faqs.q: Are there any knowledge tests required for adding a class?
faqs.a: You must have successfully completed the instructor knowledge test (90 questions) in English and without interpreter assistance for the class you are adding. However, if you are applying to upgrade within the heavy vehicle classes, you may not be required to complete the knowledge tests.
